name: library.search
description: Find scoped records by optional text, tag, and reading status.

name: library.get
description: Read one authorized record and only your own notes.

name: library.import
description: Import one catalog item into the specified library.

name: library.save_record
description: Edit bibliographic metadata, tags or reading status.

name: library.save_note
description: Save your own private note without touching another author’s note.

name: library.list_collections
description: List scoped collections and active record IDs.

name: library.rename_collection
description: Rename a collection without affecting its records.

name: library.set_membership
description: Set an active record’s collection membership.

name: library.preview_citations
description: Preview exact selected citations without saving an artifact.

name: library.export_citations
description: Persist one scoped local BibTeX export.

name: library.read_export
description: Read a scoped local citation export.

name: library.trash_record
description: Trash record while preserving its ID, notes, and membership.

name: library.restore_record
description: Restore record while preserving its ID, notes, and membership.
